newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Penrose plans to restore operations, listing.
newsitem.headline: Penrose plans to restore operations, listing.

text.p: Penrose Holdings Ltd and CTP Holdings Ltd on Friday detailed plans to restore Penrose as a viable operating company and to reinstate its listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange from April 7.
The firms said Penrose would buy a number of regional newspaper publishing businesses for 75.6 million rand to be settled by the issue of 756.38 million new Penrose shares.

Some 531.05 million of these shares will be issued to CTP which has a major interest in each of the businesses and, together with the Penrose shares already held by CTP, CTP will hold about 72.75 percent of Penrose.
